title: aubi: add stoa-auth to workspace members
description:
## What
Add crates/auth to the workspace members list in the root Cargo.toml.

## Why
stoa-auth exists on disk and is depended on by 5 crates but is NOT listed in [workspace.members]. This means cargo test --workspace and cargo clippy --workspace silently skip it. This is a pre-existing bug.

## Algorithm
1. Read /home/mark/PROJECT/stoa/Cargo.toml — find the [workspace] members array.
2. Add 'crates/auth' to the members list (alphabetically between crates/ctl and crates/core, or at the end of the crates/ group).
3. Run: cargo build --workspace 2>&1; echo EXIT:$?
4. Run: cargo test --workspace -p stoa-auth 2>&1 | tail -10

## Defensive rules
- Do not change any other Cargo.toml field.
- If adding auth breaks workspace build due to a transitive dep conflict, report immediately — do not paper over.

## Acceptance
cargo build --workspace clean; stoa-auth appears in cargo metadata workspace members
